query:
select count(*) filter (where asked_at >= ((now() at time zone 'Asia/Bishkek')::date)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Bishkek') as "day!",
                  count(*) filter (where asked_at > now() - interval '1 hour') as "hour!"
           from bot_questions
           where user_id = $1 and asked_at >= now() - interval '2 days'
             and error is distinct from $2
